interest: Spain and Switzerland brokered wartime Red Cross exchanges, including Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu's Teia Maru voyage.
overview: Four cross-reference sheets (1942–43) on wartime Red Cross exchanges through Spain and Switzerland, including Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu's travel on the Teia Maru.

people.name: Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu
people.role: Vice-President of the Japanese Red Cross

subfiles.about: A Department of State cross-reference sheet recording agreement to a proposal regarding the inclusion of Red Cross representatives and their dependents in civilian exchange.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a February 5, 1942 note to the Spanish Embassy agreeing to include Red Cross representatives in the exchange.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet on inclusion of Red Cross representatives and dependents in exchange

subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet regarding instructions sent to Switzerland seeking confirmation of the evacuation of all Red Cross personnel from Japan and Japanese-controlled areas.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Telegram No. 1033 (April 1942) seeking all Red Cross personnel in Japanese territory on the first exchange ship.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet on evacuation of Red Cross personnel on first exchange vessel

subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet noting a Japanese Government request via the Spanish Embassy for Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu and two secretaries to board the exchange ship Teia Maru.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to an August 1943 Japanese request for Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu to sail on the Teia Maru.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet on request for Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu to embark on the Teia Maru

subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet recording State Department approval for Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu and two secretaries to travel on the Teia Maru to Singapore and return.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to State's August 30, 1943 approval of Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu's Teia Maru trip to Singapore.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet approving travel of Prince Tadatsugu Shimazu on the Teia Maru to Singapore
